properties.title: Title
properties.info: Song or episode title. Accepts plain text or a CMS field binding.

ai.name: trackTitle
ai.description: Track title text, or a CMS binding such as item.title.

properties.title: Artist
properties.info: Artist, band or author shown under the title.

ai.name: trackArtist
ai.description: Artist or author name shown beneath the title.

properties.title: Cover Image URL
properties.info: Cover artwork address, or a CMS field binding. Takes priority over the fallback file below.

ai.name: imageUrl
ai.description: Cover artwork URL or CMS binding.

properties.title: Cover Alt Text
properties.info: Describes the artwork for screen readers. Falls back to the track title if left blank.

ai.name: imageAlt
ai.description: Alt text for the cover artwork.

properties.title: Audio URL
properties.info: Audio file address, or a CMS field binding. Takes priority over the fallback file below.

ai.name: audioUrl

properties.title: Cover Image File
properties.info: Used only when no Image URL is set. Drop an image here for non-CMS pages.

ai.name: imageFile
ai.description: Fallback cover image resource used when no image URL is supplied.

properties.title: Audio File
properties.info: Used only when no Audio URL is set. Drop an audio file here for non-CMS pages.

ai.name: audioFile
ai.description: Fallback audio resource used when no audio URL is supplied.

properties.title: Max Width
properties.info: Widest the card will grow. It always shrinks to fit a narrow column.

ai.name: maxWidth
ai.description: Maximum card width in pixels.

properties.title: Alignment

ai.name: cardAlign
ai.description: Card alignment within its container: centre, left or right.

properties.title: Card Padding
properties.info: Space between the card edge and its contents.

ai.name: cardPadding
ai.description: Inner padding of the card in pixels.

properties.title: Row Spacing
properties.info: Vertical space between artwork, text, transport and links.

ai.name: contentGap
ai.description: Vertical gap between stacked sections of the card.

properties.title: Show Artwork
properties.info: Show the cover artwork above the title.

ai.name: showCover
ai.description: Whether the cover artwork is displayed.

properties.title: Artwork Shape

ai.name: coverAspect

properties.title: Brand Mark Tone
properties.info: Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music and Bandcamp may only be drawn in their own brand colour, black or white, so this component uses black or white and you choose which. Pick the one your Card Background can carry — white on a dark card, black on a light one. It ships black because the card ships white. This is the card's own light or dark, not the site's, so it does not change when a visitor switches theme.

ai.name: brandIconTone
ai.description: Whether the five brand marks draw white or black. Choose to suit the Card Background; brand guidelines permit only black or white here.

properties.title: Service Icon
properties.info: Colour of the Website, Email, Feed and custom icons. The five brand marks ignore this and use Brand Mark Tone above, because their owners' guidelines do not permit an arbitrary colour.

ai.name: serviceColor
ai.description: Colour of the streaming service icons. Applies to the Website, Email, Feed and custom icons only; the five brand marks are fixed at black/white.

properties.title: Service Icon Hover
properties.info: Hover colour for the Website, Email, Feed and custom icons. The five brand marks fade slightly instead of changing colour, for the same reason.

ai.name: serviceHoverColor
ai.description: Hover colour of the streaming service icons. Applies to the Website, Email, Feed and custom icons only; the five brand marks fade instead.

properties.title: Placeholder Background
properties.info: Background of the artwork placeholder, shown when no cover loads.

ai.name: placeholderBg
ai.description: Background colour of the artwork placeholder tile.

properties.title: Placeholder Icon
properties.info: Icon colour inside the artwork placeholder.

ai.name: placeholderColor
ai.description: Icon colour within the artwork placeholder tile.

ai.name: coverRadius

ai.name: playRadius

properties.title: Show Transport
properties.info: Show the play and skip buttons. Turn off for a cover-and-links card with no playback.

ai.name: showTransport
ai.description: Whether the transport row is displayed.

properties.title: Play Icon Size
properties.info: Diameter of the play button.

ai.name: playSize
ai.description: Size of the play button in pixels.

properties.title: Skip Icon Size
properties.info: Size of the skip button icons.

ai.name: skipSize
ai.description: Size of the skip buttons in pixels.

properties.title: Button Spacing
properties.info: Space between the transport buttons.

ai.name: transportGap
ai.description: Gap between transport buttons in pixels.

properties.title: Show Circular Skip
properties.info: The outer pair of skip buttons, drawn as a circular arrow with the number of seconds inside.

ai.name: showCircleSkip
ai.description: Whether the circular skip buttons are displayed.

properties.title: Circular Skip Amount
properties.info: Seconds the circular buttons jump. The number is drawn inside the icon.

ai.name: circleSkipAmount
ai.description: Seconds skipped by the circular buttons.

properties.title: Show Arrow Skip
properties.info: The inner pair of skip buttons, drawn as arrows.

ai.name: showArrowSkip
ai.description: Whether the arrow skip buttons are displayed.

properties.title: Arrow Skip Amount
properties.info: Seconds the arrow buttons jump.

ai.name: arrowSkipAmount
ai.description: Seconds skipped by the arrow buttons.

properties.title: Arrow Style
properties.info: Arrow icon style: a bar-and-triangle skip mark, or a double chevron.

ai.name: arrowSkipStyle
ai.description: Visual style of the arrow skip buttons.

properties.title: Show Progress Bar
properties.info: Show the progress bar. It can be dragged or keyboard-seeked. Hidden while Show Transport is off, since nothing can play.

ai.name: showProgress
ai.description: Whether the progress bar is displayed.

properties.title: Progress Height
properties.info: Thickness of the progress bar.

ai.name: progressHeight
ai.description: Height of the progress bar in pixels.

properties.title: Show Time
properties.info: Show elapsed and total time beside the progress bar. The readout sits in the progress bar's row, so it goes with it.

ai.name: showTime
ai.description: Whether the time readout is displayed.

properties.title: Loop
properties.info: Restart the track automatically when it reaches the end.

ai.name: loopAudio
ai.description: Whether the audio loops.

properties.title: Pause Other Players
properties.info: Pause every other player on the page when this one starts, so two tracks never overlap.

ai.name: autoPauseOthers
ai.description: Whether starting this player pauses other players on the page.

properties.title: Download Button
properties.info: Offers the audio file as a download beneath the player. Hidden automatically when there is no audio to download.

ai.name: showDownload
ai.description: Whether a download link for the audio file is shown.

properties.title: Preload
properties.info: How much audio the browser fetches before play. Metadata reads only the duration; None waits until play is pressed and is kindest on mobile data.

ai.name: preload
ai.description: How much audio the browser preloads.
